contracts.declarative.ResourceMetadata.description:
Common metadata for all declarative resources.

# Fields

- `name`: Resource local identifier (resolver input for identity mapping)
- `description`: Human-readable description
- `tags`: Key-value pairs for filtering and organization
- `annotations`: Key-value pairs for extended metadata (not used for filtering)
- `providerRef`: The Provider the resource is filed under

name.description:
Resource name.

This is a service-scoped local identifier used by declarative identity mapping.
The final TRN resource path is resolver-derived and may compose additional
namespace context. Workspace filename matching, if required, is a loader/workspace
policy and not a contracts-level invariant.

tags.description:
Tags for filtering and organization.

Tags are key-value pairs that can be used for:
- Filtering resources in queries
- Organizing resources by environment, team, etc.

annotations.description:
Annotations for extended metadata.

Unlike tags, annotations are not used for filtering.
They're meant for storing additional metadata like:
- Creation tool information
- External system references
- Custom metadata

providerRef.description:
The Provider this resource is filed under, as a ProviderHub Provider
TRN of the resource's own tenant.

It only files the resource for filtering and display; it never
changes how the resource runs. A Provider resource carries none.

contracts.declarative.ResourceTrn.description:
A validated literal TRN reference — the final scalar value of every
declarative reference field.

enabled.description:
The sole desired activation of this trigger. Runtime faults never
change it. It is held once, on the resource: enable/disable and apply
change it, a change never publishes a version, and making another
version current leaves it as it is.

serviceAccountRef.description:
Runtime identity used by this trigger.

The trigger declares exactly one ServiceAccount reference. Permissions are
attached to that ServiceAccount through Auth policies, not stored here.

target.description: The only delivery target. Multi-target orchestration belongs to Stepflow.

schedule.description:
Cron expression accepted by `cron::Schedule`.

Common formats:
- 6 fields: `sec min hour day month weekday`
- 5 fields: `min hour day month weekday` (seconds default to `0`)

timezone.description:
IANA timezone used to interpret `schedule`.

Default: `UTC`.

startingDeadlineSeconds.description:
Maximum lateness allowed before an occurrence is skipped; every
occurrence missed by more than this is skipped, never run late.

concurrencyPolicy.description: Whether an occurrence starts while an earlier one is still active.

oneOf.description: Skip an occurrence while an earlier occurrence is active.
Start every occurrence, overlapping earlier ones.

contracts.igniter.ImapSourceConfig.description:
IMAP trigger source configuration.

```yaml
source:
  host: imap.example.com
  mailbox: INBOX
  materialRefs:
    mailbox: trn:credvault:tenant:example:credential/support-mailbox
  login:
    username: "{% auth.mailbox.username %}"
    password: "{% auth.mailbox.password %}"
  pollIntervalSeconds: 60
  start: { mode: now }
  postProcess: none
  filter:
    from: "*@vendor.example"
```

tls.description: Implicit TLS. Plain connections are for local test servers only.

materialRefs.description: Named credentials revealed under the Trigger's Service Account each round.

login.description: Explicit LOGIN parameters, mapped with the shared auth-only context.

contracts.declarative.MaterialRefs.description:
Local names mapped to literal CredVault references. A single reference
may supply several fields; different names may select the same resource.

contracts.igniter.ImapLogin.description: IMAP LOGIN parameters. Strings may contain shared material expressions.

oneOf.description: Existing messages are not delivered; only mail arriving afterwards is.

Deliver messages whose internal date is on or after `date`
(`YYYY-MM-DD`). After a UIDVALIDITY change this backfill may repeat
messages delivered under the previous UIDVALIDITY.

contracts.igniter.ImapPostProcess.description: Mailbox change applied after a message is durably admitted.

oneOf.description: Sets `\Seen`, which every mail client of the mailbox observes.

contracts.igniter.ImapFilterConfig.description: Messages that do not match are treated as processed without a delivery.

from.description: Sender address pattern; `*` matches any run of characters.

subject.description: Decoded subject pattern; `*` matches any run of characters.

contracts.igniter.PollingSourceConfig.description: Shared schedule semantics for cron-like periodic trigger sources.

schedule.description:
Cron expression accepted by `cron::Schedule`.

Common formats:
- 6 fields: `sec min hour day month weekday`
- 5 fields: `min hour day month weekday` (seconds default to `0`)

timezone.description:
IANA timezone used to interpret `schedule`.

Default: `UTC`.

startingDeadlineSeconds.description:
Maximum lateness allowed before an occurrence is skipped; every
occurrence missed by more than this is skipped, never run late.

poll.description:
Read-only operation that returns one page of items in ascending
`(itemCursor, itemId)` order across the whole logical scan.

items.description: Template returning the item array of one page response.

itemId.description: Template returning the stable identity of one item.

itemVersion.description:
Template returning the item version; set it to deliver updates of an
already delivered item.

itemCursor.description: Template returning the monotonic cursor of one item.

nextPage.description: Template returning the next page token object, or null on the last page.

contracts.igniter.PollingSourcePollConfi.description:
One original operation, its optional concrete resource binding and, for
an operation that calls through a caller-selected connection, that
connection. The operation identity is never inferred from the resource's
service or kind.

connectionRef.description:
The connection the call goes through, exactly when the operation's
call binding declares one. A connection is current state: its TRN
never carries a version qualifier.

contracts.core.OperationId.description: Typed operation identifier (`namespace.subject.action`) validated at construction.

lookbackSeconds.description:
Time cursors re-read this far behind the committed cursor; source
identity absorbs the overlap. Sequence cursors use zero.

oneOf.description: RFC 3339 timestamps; late items are re-read through the lookback window.
Integers the source never back-fills below a committed value.

contracts.igniter.PollingStart.description: First-run behavior when no cursor has been committed.

oneOf.description:
Call the poll operation in baseline mode and save the source
high-watermark it returns; existing items are not delivered.
Deliver every item after this cursor.

contracts.igniter.WebhookTriggerSource.description:
Webhook trigger source configuration.

```yaml
source:
  sourceRef: trn:igniter:tenant:example:webhook-source/github/repository-events
  connectionRef: trn:openact:tenant:example:connection/github/work
  input:
    repository: example/orders
  materialRefs:
    signing: trn:credvault:tenant:example:credential/github/orders-webhook-signing
```

sourceRef.description:
Stable Webhook Source TRN. A request uses the Source as it is when
the request is admitted.

input.description: Instance parameters validated against the Source's inputSchema.

connectionRef.description:
The account the Source's subscription callbacks call through: an
OpenAct Connection TRN, stable or with a `v<n>` qualifier. Declared
exactly when the callbacks call through a connection.

The connection the call goes through, exactly when the operation's
call binding declares one. A connection is current state: its TRN
never carries a version qualifier.
